name: io.github.matthewliu10/waterloo-brightspace
description: Local MCP server for Waterloo LEARN. Check grades, assignments, due dates, and announcements.

environmentVariables.name: D2L_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Local root for separate per-school/account directories containing encrypted tokens and browser storage. Encryption keys are kept in the native credential store. Default: ~/.d2l-session

environmentVariables.name: D2L_TOKEN_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds an access token is used before it is re-minted from the session cookie. Default: 3600

environmentVariables.name: D2L_INCLUDE_COURSES
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to include. Default: all enrolled courses.

environmentVariables.name: D2L_EXCLUDE_COURSES
environmentVariables.description: Comma separated course (org unit) ids to exclude.

environmentVariables.name: D2L_ACTIVE_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Only return courses whose enrollment is active. Default: true
